visualStyle.color: rich saturated skin tones and blue

analysis.themes: One man's life in three chapters — the performance of masculinity built to survive Miami's streets slowly suffocates the tenderness beneath it.
analysis.atmosphere: Tender and melancholic; the film holds its character with a gentleness the world around him never does.
analysis.narrative: Three ages, three actors, one consciousness — the gaps between chapters carry the unlived years.
analysis.visual: James Laxton's saturated, blue-tinged photography makes skin luminous — 'in moonlight, black boys look blue.'
analysis.characters: Chiron barely speaks across the whole film; the camera does the interiority. Juan and Teresa are the warmth he builds his armor against losing.
